Seer.directive_rationale: Your early claim and clearance of the Guard provided the village with essential ground truth.
Seer.actual_player_behavior: Hoang stated, 'I am the Seer. I investigated Nhan, and he was not a werewolf.'
Seer.verdict_notes: Hoang revealed his role and provided his investigation result in Round 1 Debate.

Seer.directive_rationale: Your early claim and clearance of the Guard provided the village with essential ground truth.
Seer.verdict_notes: The Guard (Nhan) was eliminated in Night 1, so he could not be confirmed during a debate phase for endorsement.

Seer.directive_rationale: The Seer, Guard, and Witch did not establish a private or public trust loop to ensure the Seer's survival
Seer.actual_player_behavior: Hoang publicly cleared Cong (the Witch) by stating, 'I investigated Cong last night; he is NOT a werewolf.'
Seer.verdict_notes: Hoang established trust with the Witch via a public clearance, but there is no evidence of a 'loop' or coordinated survival strategy with the Guard, who was already dead.

Guard.directive_rationale: The Seer is the village's most valuable asset; you must protect them every single night until they are dead.
Guard.verdict_notes: Nhan protected the Witch instead of the Seer (Hoang).

Guard.directive_rationale: The Seer, Guard, and Witch did not establish a private or public trust loop to ensure the Seer's survival
Guard.verdict_notes: Nhan was eliminated in Night 1 and did not participate in any Day Debate.

Witch.directive_rationale: The Save potion should have been reserved for the Seer
Witch.actual_player_behavior: Cong used the SAVE potion on Hoang (Seer).
Witch.verdict_notes: Cong used the save potion to protect the Seer during Night 2.

Witch.directive_rationale: the Poison potion should have been used on the players utilizing 'Confusion Masks' (stalling role claims) in Round 1.
Witch.actual_player_behavior: Cong did not use any potions during Night 1.
Witch.verdict_notes: Meg used a deflection tactic/confusion mask in Round 1 Debate, but Cong did not use the poison potion in the preceding or following night to target her.

Witch.directive_rationale: The Seer, Guard, and Witch did not establish a private or public trust loop to ensure the Seer's survival
Witch.actual_player_behavior: Cong voted for Riley, supporting the Seer's lead by stating, 'We must follow Hoang's guidance and exile Riley now.'
Witch.verdict_notes: Cong publicly aligned with and endorsed the Seer, though a full 'trust loop' was not explicitly formed.

Villager.directive_rationale: continue to demand immediate role claims and treat any hesitation as a high-probability wolf signal.
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Jin and Nam both demanded roles immediately; when Meg questioned the process, Jin accused her: 'Meg, your behavior is a textbook wolf signal.'
Villager.verdict_notes: Jin and Nam treated Meg's refusal to simply claim a role as a wolf signal and accused her.

Villager.directive_rationale: continue to demand immediate role claims
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Jin stated, 'everyone must reveal their roles immediately... Cong, Nam, Hoang, Riley, and Meg—state your roles now.' Nam added, 'Cong, Hoang, Riley, Meg—claim now.'
Villager.verdict_notes: Both villagers aggressively demanded immediate role claims from all remaining players.
